title: One tenant schema in the deploy's migration fan-out
caption: packages/db migrate.js tenants (run by velexis-deploy as velexis_migrator with SET LOCAL ROLE velexis_provisioner); MIGRATE_TENANT_CONCURRENCY (4) and MIGRATE_TENANT_MAX_FAILURE_RATIO (0.1) from migrator.env.

states.label: Failed (SQLSTATE in the report)
states.detail: Fan-out continues. More than 10 % failed → exit 3, deploy aborted, old release keeps running. 10 % or fewer → exit 0 and the deploy switches anyway; each failed tenant gets an ops alert e-mail (tenant.migration_failed event).
